title: Wegic Review (2026)
intro: Wegic is evaluated here as an AI website builder — Wegic is an AI website builder that generates sites from conversational prompts — layout, copy, and basic commerce. Free trial supports evaluation. Published starter pricing is commonly cited around $12–15/mo (medium confidence — confirm live). Higher tiers and custom packaging may require sales contact. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Wegic when building a small business website via AI chat is the primary job — not when you need slide decks or ad banners.
verdict: Choose Wegic when building a small business website via AI chat is the primary job — not when you need slide decks or ad banners. Compare Gamma for presentations and microsites, and traditional builders (Wix, Squarespace) if you need mature connector ecosystems. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Conversational site building reduces traditional builder learning curve — approachable for founders. Score from first-party positioning, not lab testing.
Primary job is AI website generation from prompts — strong ai-website-builder cluster fit. Not scored against LLM assistants.
Generated sites are adequate for SMB landing pages and portfolios — held at 7 vs custom dev or mature builder polish.
Chat editing and hosting cover basic site lifecycle — shallower than full marketing suites or agent builders.
Limited native connectors — Zapier-style and basic embeds; trails established website builder ecosystems.
SMB-grade hosting posture — adequate for small business sites, not enterprise web governance.
Starter → Pro path supports growing sites; pricing confidence and sales-gated tiers add scaling friction.
~$12/mo starter is competitive if confirmed live, but medium pricing confidence and trial-only entry vs free competitors temper the score. Affiliate economics excluded.
Site-generation models are capable for SMB sites — not general flagship LLM reasoning depth.
